# package report

`import "github.com/lestrrat-3d/decad/report"`

[Module index](<README.md>)

<a name="pkg-overview"></a>
## Overview

Package report holds the result vocabulary the decad contact, sweep, motion
and linkage queries publish. The decad package aliases these types with
its own handles filled in ([decad.ContactReport](<decad.md#ContactReport>) is
[ContactReportOf](<#ContactReportOf>)\[\*[decad.Body](<decad.md#Body>), \*[decad.Face](<decad.md#Face>), \*[decad.Edge](<decad.md#Edge>), \*[decad.Vertex](<decad.md#Vertex>)\]), so
callers normally name them through decad.

### type Assessment

<pre>type Assessment <a href="https://pkg.go.dev/builtin#int">int</a></pre>

Assessment is a stated spec's verdict against a [ScalarOutcome](<#ScalarOutcome>) or [Coverage](<#Coverage>)

asked.

    // AssessmentMet — the requirement holds.
    AssessmentMet
    // AssessmentViolated — the requirement is proven to fail.
    AssessmentViolated
    // AssessmentUndecided — no comparison can be proved.
    AssessmentUndecided
)</pre>

<a name="BodyReportOf"></a>
### type BodyReportOf

<pre>type BodyReportOf[BodyT <a href="https://pkg.go.dev/builtin#comparable">comparable</a>, FaceT <a href="https://pkg.go.dev/builtin#any">any</a>, CellT <a href="https://pkg.go.dev/builtin#any">any</a>] struct {
    Body          BodyT
    Status        <a href="#Status">Status</a>
    Validity      <a href="#ValidityResultOf">ValidityResultOf</a>[BodyT, CellT]
    Topology      <a href="#HeldTopology">HeldTopology</a>
    Area          <a href="#ScalarReading">ScalarReading</a>
    Bounds        <a href="#BoundsReading">BoundsReading</a>
    Region        *<a href="#RegionReadings">RegionReadings</a>
    Wall          <a href="#WallResultOf">WallResultOf</a>[BodyT, CellT]
    Undercut      <a href="#UndercutResultOf">UndercutResultOf</a>[BodyT, FaceT, CellT]
    ConcaveRadius <a href="#ConcaveRadiusResultOf">ConcaveRadiusResultOf</a>[BodyT, CellT]
    Diagnostics   []<a href="#DiagnosticOf">DiagnosticOf</a>[BodyT, CellT]
}</pre>

BodyReportOf is one live body's verdict and readings (verification §1,
proposal §3). Area and Bounds are unconditional boundary readings on
every returned body; Region carries the two region quantities and is
non-nil exactly when Validity.Outcome is ValidityValid (proposal §9).
Every successful Verify call fills Validity.Outcome, Wall.Outcome,
Undercut.Coverage, and ConcaveRadius.Outcome nonzero — NotRequested for an
omitted survey — though this guarantee does not extend to [Assessment](<#Assessment>) or
Tolerance states (proposal §4). Diagnostics is the deterministic
flattening of Validity's, the core readings', Wall's, Undercut's, and
ConcaveRadius's own local diagnostics, in that order, each finding
present exactly once even though it is also reachable through its own
result's local Diagnostics slice (proposal §10); it is empty exactly when
[Status](<#Status>) is Sound.

<a name="ClearanceOf"></a>
### type ClearanceOf

<pre>type ClearanceOf[BodyT <a href="https://pkg.go.dev/builtin#comparable">comparable</a>] struct {
    A, B BodyT
    Gap  <a href="#Measurement">Measurement</a>
}</pre>

ClearanceOf is the minimum gap between a pair of proven-disjoint bodies
(verification §1). A row exists only for a pair proven disjoint with a
measured gap: the clearance kernel (agent-docs/clearance-design.md) proves the
gap as an interval, and Gap reports its midpoint with the interval's half
width as the proven Bound — Exact exactly when the interval is a point. A
touching pair's zero is a measured Exact zero carried by a certified
contact; a pair whose gap the kernel cannot prove yields no row and reads
Suspect under WithClearances.

For a pair holding a sheet operand, the row means something narrower
(agent-docs/surface-design.md §9.3): a sheet has no volume to be disjoint FROM,
so Gap states the proven distance between the sheet and the solid's
boundary, whether the sheet lies wholly inside or wholly outside it, WITHOUT
asserting which side. A solid-solid row's meaning is unchanged.

<a name="Coverage"></a>
### type Coverage

<pre>type Coverage <a href="https://pkg.go.dev/builtin#int">int</a></pre>

Coverage is the undercut survey's primary outcome: how completely the
producer decided face membership against the requested pull direction.
Every successful Verify call fills this nonzero on every returned
BodyReport's Undercut result — CoverageNotRequested for a call that did
not ask.

<a name="CoverageNotEvaluated"></a><a name="CoverageNotRequested"></a><a name="CoverageUnavailable"></a><a name="CoverageUndecided"></a><a name="CoveragePartial"></a><a name="CoverageComplete"></a>

<pre>const (
    // CoverageNotEvaluated is the reserved zero value: only a zero or
    // caller-created record carries it, never a value Verify returns.
    CoverageNotEvaluated <a href="#Coverage">Coverage</a> = iota
    // CoverageNotRequested — the pull direction was not requested.
    CoverageNotRequested
    // CoverageUnavailable — a prerequisite or payload capability prevents
    // the survey.
    CoverageUnavailable
    // CoverageUndecided — the producer certifies neither a complete list
    // nor any opposing face.
    CoverageUndecided
    // CoveragePartial — confirmed opposing faces exist and other
    // membership remains undecided.
    CoveragePartial
    // CoverageComplete — every face was decided; Faces lists every
    // opposing face, empty when none opposes.
    CoverageComplete
)</pre>

<a name="DiagnosticCode"></a>
### type DiagnosticCode

<pre>type DiagnosticCode <a href="https://pkg.go.dev/builtin#int">int</a></pre>

DiagnosticCode is the stable, branchable reason code (verification §1.1) — a
named-text enum whose stable String() token, never the iota value, is the
identity a caller and a log share.

<a name="DiagMeasurementBeyondTolerance"></a><a name="DiagUndecidedValidity"></a><a name="DiagInvalidBody"></a><a name="DiagWallTooThin"></a><a name="DiagUndercut"></a><a name="DiagUndecidedWall"></a><a name="DiagUndecidedUndercut"></a><a name="DiagUndecidedMinRadius"></a><a name="DiagInterference"></a><a name="DiagUndecidedPair"></a><a name="DiagUndecidedClearance"></a><a name="DiagUndecidedInterference"></a><a name="DiagUnsupportedPairPayload"></a><a name="DiagUnsupportedPairContact"></a><a name="DiagUnsupportedPairPipeline"></a><a name="DiagUnsupportedPairSheet"></a><a name="DiagSheetSolidCrossing"></a><a name="DiagUnsupportedSurveyPayload"></a><a name="DiagSurveyPrerequisite"></a><a name="DiagToleranceReferenceUnavailable"></a><a name="DiagMotionCollision"></a><a name="DiagMotionClearanceViolated"></a><a name="DiagMotionUndecidedInterval"></a><a name="DiagMotionUndecidedClearance"></a><a name="DiagJointBoxBudgetExhausted"></a>

<pre>const (
    // DiagMeasurementBeyondTolerance — a bounded reading&#39;s Bound exceeds rel*Ref
    // (§2). Reading names the quantity; its Observed* form carries it, Required
    // is rel*Ref (the largest Bound that would have passed). Body set on a body
    // reading, Pair on a pair reading. Contributes Suspect.
    DiagMeasurementBeyondTolerance <a href="#DiagnosticCode">DiagnosticCode</a> = iota
    // DiagUndecidedValidity — the held boundary is not decisive beyond its own
    // proven bound (§6). Reading ReadingNone. Contributes Suspect.
    DiagUndecidedValidity
    // DiagInvalidBody — the held boundary is proven not a valid solid (§6).
    // Reading ReadingNone. Contributes Unsound.
    DiagInvalidBody
    // DiagWallTooThin — MinWallThickness&#39;s proven interval is below the tool
    // (§6). Reading ReadingWall, Observed the wall reading, Required the tool.
    // Contributes Violating.
    DiagWallTooThin
    // DiagUndercut — a face is a proven undercut against the pull (§6). Reading
    // ReadingNone, every Observed* and Required nil. Contributes Violating.
    DiagUndercut
    // DiagUndecidedWall — the wall survey is undecided: neither answered nor
    // proven absent, OR its proven interval STRADDLES the tool (§6). In the
    // straddle case Reading is ReadingWall with Observed the wall reading and
    // Required the tool; when the survey could not answer at all Reading is
    // ReadingNone and both are nil. Contributes Suspect.
    DiagUndecidedWall
    // DiagUndecidedUndercut — the pull survey could neither prove nor exclude an
    // undercut (§6). Reading ReadingNone. Contributes Suspect.
    DiagUndecidedUndercut
    // DiagUndecidedMinRadius — the concave-radius survey could neither measure
    // nor exclude a concave feature (§6). Reading ReadingNone. Contributes
    // Suspect.
    DiagUndecidedMinRadius
    // DiagInterference — a pair proven to overlap (§1). Reading
    // ReadingOverlapVolume, Observed the overlap volume, Required nil.
    // Contributes Interfering.
    DiagInterference
    // DiagUndecidedPair — a pair the disjoint/overlap PARTITION proof resolved
    // neither way (§1). Reading ReadingNone. Contributes Suspect.
    DiagUndecidedPair
    // DiagUndecidedClearance — a pair PROVEN disjoint (by box or kernel) whose
    // requested WithClearances gap the kernel could not prove: no Clearance row
    // is emitted and the report reads Suspect. Distinct from DiagUndecidedPair
    // (partition unresolved) and the cause-specific unsupported-pair codes
    // (payload, contact, or pipeline) — here the pair is decidedly apart and
    // only the gap is unmeasured. Reading ReadingNone. Contributes Suspect.
    DiagUndecidedClearance
    // DiagUndecidedInterference — a pair PROVEN to overlap whose overlap VOLUME
    // the evaluator cannot bound (§1): the overlap-side mirror of
    // DiagUndecidedClearance. No Interference row is emitted and the report reads
    // Suspect. Reading ReadingNone, Observed and Required nil, Pair set.
    // Contributes Suspect.
    DiagUndecidedInterference
    // DiagUnsupportedPairPayload — one named operand could not enter the read-only
    // intersection: either its mesh carries no occupied-volume proof, or at the
    // chord tolerance the check derives from the pair its own tessellation
    // refused or its held facets where the pair meets are coarser than that
    // tolerance. The message names which. Reading ReadingNone. Contributes Suspect.
    DiagUnsupportedPairPayload
    // DiagUnsupportedPairContact — the pair reaches a contact or near-contact the
    // exact boolean policy cannot classify. Reading ReadingNone. Contributes Suspect.
    // Message names a shared face plane between the operands when they have one,
    // since deepening the overlap cannot resolve that cause.
    DiagUnsupportedPairContact
    // DiagUnsupportedPairPipeline — both operands tessellate, but later boolean
    // geometry exceeds the pipeline&#39;s supported reach. Reading ReadingNone.
    // Contributes Suspect.
    DiagUnsupportedPairPipeline
    // DiagUnsupportedPairSheet — a pair holding a sheet operand that the
    // sheet decision procedure could not settle (agent-docs/surface-design.md
    // §9.3): a sheet-sheet pair, since neither operand offers a closed
    // boundary to cast the other against, or a sheet-against-solid pair
    // whose body model is missing, whose candidate enumeration could not
    // decide the boundary distance, or whose witness cast failed. It fires
    // only when the pair&#39;s bounds-inflated boxes MEET: a sheet parked away
    // from every solid is decidedly apart and emits nothing, so a model that
    // merely holds a sheet still reads Sound. Reading ReadingNone, Observed*
    // and Required nil, Pair set. Contributes Suspect.
    DiagUnsupportedPairSheet
    // DiagSheetSolidCrossing — a sheet operand proven to cross a solid
    // operand&#39;s boundary, by an admitted transversal crossing between a
    // sheet face and a solid face (agent-docs/surface-design.md §9.3). A sheet
    // encloses no region, so no Interference row is emitted for it — that
    // absence is NOT a proven non-overlap here, only the fact that a sheet
    // has no overlap volume to report. Reading ReadingNone, every Observed*,
    // Required and Body nil, Pair set. Contributes Interfering.
    DiagSheetSolidCrossing
    // DiagUnsupportedSurveyPayload — an asked body survey cannot run because
    // its payload class is staged. Reading ReadingNone. Contributes Suspect.
    DiagUnsupportedSurveyPayload
    // DiagSurveyPrerequisite — a requested survey needs a proven solid, and
    // this body does not supply one: its validity is invalid or undecided, OR
    // it is a sheet body asking a wall or concave-radius question, neither of
    // which has any material on a sheet to be about
    // (agent-docs/surface-design.md §9.1). An undercut question is not blocked this
    // way on a proven-valid surface-extruded prism sheet, which answers it
    // over the sheet&#39;s own positive side; every other sheet family still
    // reads DiagUnsupportedSurveyPayload for it instead. Survey names the
    // blocked question, Reading ReadingNone. Contributes Suspect.
    DiagSurveyPrerequisite
    // DiagToleranceReferenceUnavailable — a nonzero-bound reading has no
    // usable tolerance reference, so the gate could not judge it. Reading
    // names the quantity, Required nil. Contributes Suspect.
    DiagToleranceReferenceUnavailable
    // DiagMotionCollision — a motion pose proves a (mover, static) pair
    // overlaps (agent-docs/motion-check-design.md §4.1). Pair and At set; Reading
    // ReadingOverlapVolume with Observed the volume when it was bounded, else
    // ReadingNone. Contributes Interfering.
    DiagMotionCollision
    // DiagMotionClearanceViolated — a motion pose proves a pair&#39;s gap below
    // the WithMinClearance minimum. Pair and At set, Reading ReadingGap,
    // Observed the gap, Required the minimum. Contributes Violating.
    DiagMotionClearanceViolated
    // DiagMotionUndecidedInterval — a motion interval neither certified clear
    // nor bounded by a proven collision. Pair nil, At the interval&#39;s From,
    // Reading ReadingNone; Message names both ends. Contributes Suspect.
    DiagMotionUndecidedInterval
    // DiagMotionUndecidedClearance — a motion interval certified clear whose
    // lower bound does not reach the WithMinClearance minimum while no pose
    // falsifies it. At the interval&#39;s From, Reading ReadingGap, Observed the
    // interval&#39;s lower bound, Required the minimum. Contributes Suspect.
    DiagMotionUndecidedClearance
    // DiagJointBoxBudgetExhausted — WithCellBudget stopped a joint-box split
    // the resolution would have allowed (agent-docs/linkage-check-design.md §14.2).
    // Raised at most once per report; Pair, Body and Cell nil, Reading
    // ReadingNone; Message names the budget and the cells it held.
    // Contributes Suspect.
    DiagJointBoxBudgetExhausted
)</pre>

<pre>func (c <a href="#DiagnosticCode">DiagnosticCode</a>) String() <a href="https://pkg.go.dev/builtin#string">string</a></pre>

String renders the pinned lower-snake token — the identity a caller branches
on and a log prints, never the iota value. An out-of-range value renders
"diagnostic(\<n\>)", never a panic (verification §1.1).

<a name="DiagnosticOf"></a>
### type DiagnosticOf

<pre>type DiagnosticOf[BodyT <a href="https://pkg.go.dev/builtin#comparable">comparable</a>, CellT <a href="https://pkg.go.dev/builtin#any">any</a>] struct {
    Code        <a href="#DiagnosticCode">DiagnosticCode</a>           // the stable branch key
    Status      <a href="#Status">Status</a>                   // the rung this reason contributes
    Body        BodyT                    // the body it concerns; nil for a pair diagnostic
    Pair        *<a href="#DiagnosticPairOf">DiagnosticPairOf</a>[BodyT] // the pair it concerns; nil for a body diagnostic
    Survey      <a href="#SurveyKind">SurveyKind</a>               // which optional body survey this concerns; SurveyNone for core/pair reasons
    Reading     <a href="#ReadingKind">ReadingKind</a>              // which quantity the Observed* form carries; ReadingNone names none
    Observed    *<a href="#Measurement">Measurement</a>             // a scalar reading; nil unless Reading names a scalar quantity
    ObservedVec *<a href="#VecMeasurement">VecMeasurement</a>          // a vector reading (a Centroid); nil unless Reading == ReadingCentroid
    ObservedBox *<a href="#Box">Box</a>                     // a box reading (a Bounds); nil unless Reading == ReadingBounds
    Required    *units.Value             // the threshold the reading was judged against; nil when the reason states none
    At          *units.Value             // the motion parameter a VerifyMotion finding concerns; nil outside motion reports
    Cell        *CellT                   // the joint cell a VerifyJointBox finding concerns; nil outside joint-box reports
    Message     <a href="https://pkg.go.dev/builtin#string">string</a>                   // human-readable; NEVER the branch key
}</pre>

DiagnosticOf is one structured, branchable reason a body or a pair is not Sound
(verification §1.1). It never decides the verdict — [Status](<#Status>) is still §6's
worst-wins aggregate — it explains it. Exactly one of Observed / ObservedVec
/ ObservedBox is non-nil, keyed by Reading (all three nil when
Reading == ReadingNone). Survey identifies which optional body survey the
reason concerns — SurveyNone for every core reading and every pair
diagnostic — set even when Reading is ReadingNone, so an unsupported wall,
undercut, or concave-radius refusal is distinguished without inspecting
Message text. At is the motion parameter a VerifyMotion finding concerns
(agent-docs/motion-check-design.md §4.1); it is nil on every diagnostic Verify
emits and on every motion finding about the whole path. Cell is the joint
cell a VerifyJointBox finding concerns (agent-docs/linkage-check-design.md §14.2);
it is nil on every diagnostic Verify, VerifyMotion and VerifyLinkage emit.

<a name="ReportOf"></a>
### type ReportOf

<pre>type ReportOf[BodyT <a href="https://pkg.go.dev/builtin#comparable">comparable</a>, FaceT <a href="https://pkg.go.dev/builtin#any">any</a>, CellT <a href="https://pkg.go.dev/builtin#any">any</a>] struct {
    Request       <a href="#VerifyRequest">VerifyRequest</a>
    Bodies        []*<a href="#BodyReportOf">BodyReportOf</a>[BodyT, FaceT, CellT]
    Interferences []<a href="#InterferenceOf">InterferenceOf</a>[BodyT]
    Clearances    []<a href="#ClearanceOf">ClearanceOf</a>[BodyT]
    Diagnostics   []<a href="#DiagnosticOf">DiagnosticOf</a>[BodyT, CellT]
    Status        <a href="#Status">Status</a>
}</pre>

ReportOf is what Verify returns: the 3D counterpart of
sketch.VerificationReport (core §10, verification §1). Request records the
validated effective settings this call used, including defaults, even for
an empty document (proposal §5). Bodies follows Document.Bodies() order at
the call. Diagnostics is the canonical inventory for counting and logging
the whole call: body diagnostics in body order, then pair diagnostics in
pair order, each finding present exactly once (proposal §10, §11); it is
empty EXACTLY when [Status](<#Status>) == Sound, and [Status](<#Status>) is the worst
[DiagnosticOf](<#DiagnosticOf>).Status in it. The zero Report is Unverified and carries no
verdict.

<a name="LiftVerifyReport"></a>
#### func LiftVerifyReport

<pre>func LiftVerifyReport[B1 <a href="https://pkg.go.dev/builtin#comparable">comparable</a>, F1 <a href="https://pkg.go.dev/builtin#any">any</a>, B2 <a href="https://pkg.go.dev/builtin#comparable">comparable</a>, F2 <a href="https://pkg.go.dev/builtin#any">any</a>](l *<a href="#RefLift">RefLift</a>[B1, F1, B2, F2], r *<a href="#ReportOf">ReportOf</a>[B1, F1, <a href="#JointCell">JointCell</a>]) *<a href="#ReportOf">ReportOf</a>[B2, F2, <a href="#JointCell">JointCell</a>]</pre>

LiftVerifyReport returns r with every body and face reference mapped by l.
The request, its wall and undercut pointers and every reading carry over;
nil and empty slices keep their state. A nil report stays nil.

<a name="ReportOf.ForBody"></a>
#### func (\*ReportOf\[BodyT, FaceT, CellT\]) ForBody

<pre>func (r *<a href="#ReportOf">ReportOf</a>[BodyT, FaceT, CellT]) ForBody(body BodyT) (*<a href="#BodyReportOf">BodyReportOf</a>[BodyT, FaceT, CellT], <a href="https://pkg.go.dev/builtin#error">error</a>)</pre>

ForBody looks up body's BodyReport by exact pointer identity (proposal
§11). A nil receiver or a nil body returns ErrDegenerate. Any absent
non-nil identity, including a foreign body, returns
ErrBodyReportNotFound. Successful lookup returns the report's own
existing pointer and performs no verification: it consults only this
[ReportOf](<#ReportOf>)'s recorded bodies, never current document membership or liveness,
so it still resolves a body later retired from its document.

<a name="ReportOf.Passed"></a>
#### func (\*ReportOf\[BodyT, FaceT, CellT\]) Passed

<pre>func (r *<a href="#ReportOf">ReportOf</a>[BodyT, FaceT, CellT]) Passed() <a href="https://pkg.go.dev/builtin#bool">bool</a></pre>

Passed reports whether the whole report is Sound for the effective request,
including the default interference check (proposal §1, §4). It does not
imply that every optional survey ran — Wall, Undercut, and ConcaveRadius
can each read NotRequested on a Sound report. It returns false for a nil
[ReportOf](<#ReportOf>) and for any [Status](<#Status>) other than Sound, including an unrecognized one:
it is a convenience predicate over [Status](<#Status>), not a validator of a
caller-built or decoded Report, so an unrecognized nested result enum
never overrides a caller-assigned Sound [Status](<#Status>).

<a name="ScalarOutcome"></a>
### type ScalarOutcome

<pre>type ScalarOutcome <a href="https://pkg.go.dev/builtin#int">int</a></pre>

ScalarOutcome is a whole-body scalar survey's primary outcome (Wall or
ConcaveRadius): whether the question was asked, and if so, whether the
solid prerequisite or payload allows it, the survey could decide it, no
feature exists, or a minimum was proven. Every successful Verify call
fills this nonzero on every returned BodyReport's Wall and ConcaveRadius
results — ScalarNotRequested for a survey the call did not ask.

<a name="ScalarNotEvaluated"></a><a name="ScalarNotRequested"></a><a name="ScalarUnavailable"></a><a name="ScalarUndecided"></a><a name="ScalarAbsent"></a><a name="ScalarMeasured"></a>

<pre>const (
    // ScalarNotEvaluated is the reserved zero value: only a zero or
    // caller-created record carries it, never a value Verify returns.
    ScalarNotEvaluated <a href="#ScalarOutcome">ScalarOutcome</a> = iota
    // ScalarNotRequested — this call did not ask this question.
    ScalarNotRequested
    // ScalarUnavailable — the solid prerequisite failed, or this payload has
    // no implemented survey.
    ScalarUnavailable
    // ScalarUndecided — the survey could not certify the whole minimum or
    // its absence.
    ScalarUndecided
    // ScalarAbsent — no feature in the survey&#39;s defined class exists.
    ScalarAbsent
    // ScalarMeasured — the reading encloses the actual whole-body minimum.
    ScalarMeasured
)</pre>

<a name="ScalarOutcome.String"></a>
#### func (ScalarOutcome) String

<pre>func (o <a href="#ScalarOutcome">ScalarOutcome</a>) String() <a href="https://pkg.go.dev/builtin#string">string</a></pre>

String renders the pinned lower-snake token. An out-of-range value renders
"scalar\_outcome(\<n\>)", never a panic.

<a name="ScalarReading"></a>
### type ScalarReading

<pre>type ScalarReading struct {
    <a href="#Measurement">Measurement</a>
    Tolerance <a href="#ToleranceResult">ToleranceResult</a>
}</pre>

ScalarReading is a scalar measurement plus its tolerance verdict
(proposal §8). Embedding [Measurement](<#Measurement>) gives callers typed value access
(.Value, .Exactness, .Bound) with Tolerance as a separate decision.

<a name="Status"></a>
### type Status

<pre>type Status <a href="https://pkg.go.dev/builtin#int">int</a></pre>

Status is a verdict, used at both the body and the report level
(verification §6). Unverified is the reserved zero value and is never
returned by a successful Verify. Severity among verification results is by
precedence, worst wins: Unsound \> Interfering \> Violating \> Suspect \> Sound.

<a name="Unverified"></a><a name="Sound"></a><a name="Suspect"></a><a name="Violating"></a><a name="Interfering"></a><a name="Unsound"></a>

<pre>const (
    // Unverified: no verification produced this value. It is reserved so a
    // zero or partially decoded Report fails Passed.
    Unverified <a href="#Status">Status</a> = iota
    // Sound: every body a proven solid, every stated spec met, every asked
    // absence proven, nothing approximate beyond tolerance.
    Sound
    // Suspect: nothing proven wrong and something not proven right — an
    // answer beyond the caller&#39;s tolerance, an asked question undecided, an
    // undecided pair.
    Suspect
    // Violating: a spec a VerifyOption stated is proven to fail.
    Violating
    // Interfering: bodies provenly overlap. A report verdict only — overlap
    // is a property of a pair, so no single body is ever Interfering.
    Interfering
    // Unsound: some body is proven not a valid solid.
    Unsound
)</pre>

<a name="Status.String"></a>
#### func (Status) String

<pre>func (s <a href="#Status">Status</a>) String() <a href="https://pkg.go.dev/builtin#string">string</a></pre>

String renders the status for diagnostics.

<a name="SurveyKind"></a>
### type SurveyKind

<pre>type SurveyKind <a href="https://pkg.go.dev/builtin#int">int</a></pre>

SurveyKind identifies which optional body survey a Diagnostic concerns
(verification §1.1). SurveyNone means no optional body survey applies — as
for a core reading or a pair diagnostic — and is NOT an unevaluated marker:
it is the correct, permanent value for every diagnostic outside the three
opt-in surveys.

<a name="SurveyNone"></a><a name="SurveyWall"></a><a name="SurveyUndercut"></a><a name="SurveyConcaveRadius"></a>

<pre>const (
    // SurveyNone — no optional body survey applies; every core or pair
    // diagnostic carries this.
    SurveyNone <a href="#SurveyKind">SurveyKind</a> = iota
    // SurveyWall — the wall-thickness survey (WithMinWallThickness).
    SurveyWall
    // SurveyUndercut — the pull-direction survey (WithPullDirection).
    SurveyUndercut
    // SurveyConcaveRadius — the concave-radius survey (WithConcaveRadius).
    SurveyConcaveRadius
)</pre>

<a name="SurveyKind.String"></a>
#### func (SurveyKind) String

<pre>func (k <a href="#SurveyKind">SurveyKind</a>) String() <a href="https://pkg.go.dev/builtin#string">string</a></pre>

String renders the pinned lower-snake token. An out-of-range value renders
"survey\_kind(\<n\>)", never a panic (verification §1.1).

<a name="LiftSweepContactTrack"></a>
#### func LiftSweepContactTrack

<pre>func LiftSweepContactTrack[B1, F1, E1, V1, B2, F2, E2, V2 <a href="https://pkg.go.dev/builtin#any">any</a>](_ seal.Key, t *<a href="#SweepContactTrackOf">SweepContactTrackOf</a>[F1, E1, V1],
    l *<a href="#Lift">Lift</a>[B1, F1, E1, V1, B2, F2, E2, V2]) *<a href="#SweepContactTrackOf">SweepContactTrackOf</a>[F2, E2, V2]</pre>

LiftSweepContactTrack returns t with its features and manifolds mapped by l.
It keeps t's source record; a nil track stays nil. The track holds l by
pointer, so tracks lifted by one [Lift](<#Lift>) compare deeply equal.

<a name="NewSweepContactTrack"></a>
#### func NewSweepContactTrack

<pre>func NewSweepContactTrack[F, E, V <a href="https://pkg.go.dev/builtin#any">any</a>](_ seal.Key, proof <a href="#SweepTrack">SweepTrack</a>[F, E, V], source <a href="https://pkg.go.dev/builtin#any">any</a>) *<a href="#SweepContactTrackOf">SweepContactTrackOf</a>[F, E, V]</pre>

NewSweepContactTrack wraps a producer's exact track proof. source is the
producer's own record of it, which Source returns.

<a name="SweepContactTrackOf.Band"></a>
#### func (\*SweepContactTrackOf\[F, E, V\]) Band

<pre>func (t *<a href="#SweepContactTrackOf">SweepContactTrackOf</a>[F, E, V]) Band() *<a href="#Measurement">Measurement</a></pre>

Band returns the depth of a band track (agent-docs/multibody-dynamics-design.md
§10.3), a Length [Measurement](<#Measurement>) whose Value plus Bound bounds every contact
point's separation in both directions and the interiors' overlap along
Normal(). It is nil for an exact touch track.

<a name="SweepContactTrackOf.BandAt"></a>
#### func (\*SweepContactTrackOf\[F, E, V\]) BandAt

<pre>func (t *<a href="#SweepContactTrackOf">SweepContactTrackOf</a>[F, E, V]) BandAt(fraction units.Value) (*<a href="#Measurement">Measurement</a>, <a href="https://pkg.go.dev/builtin#error">error</a>)</pre>

BandAt returns the depth of a band track over its prefix through fraction
(agent-docs/multibody-dynamics-design.md §10.3): a Length [Measurement](<#Measurement>) whose Value
plus Bound bounds every contact point's separation in both directions and
the interiors' overlap along Normal() at every instant from the track's
start through fraction. At the track's end it is at most Band(); it grows
with fraction, so a caller can end a slice where the band reaches its own
residual. It is nil for an exact touch track.

End is the last instant of the certified interval.

<a name="SweepClear"></a><a name="SweepDepartedClear"></a><a name="SweepPersistentTouch"></a><a name="SweepContactTransitionBracket"></a><a name="SweepImpactBracket"></a><a name="SweepInitiallyTouching"></a><a name="SweepInitiallyOverlapping"></a><a name="SweepUndecided"></a><a name="SweepGrazingTouch"></a><a name="SweepPersistentBand"></a>

    SweepImpactBracket
    SweepInitiallyTouching
    SweepInitiallyOverlapping
    SweepUndecided
    SweepGrazingTouch
    // SweepPersistentBand: the pair stays within a certified band of one
    // normal through its contact track. At every instant of the track the
    // signed separation along Normal() of every point the track publishes
    // lies in [−Depth, Depth], the interiors overlap by at most Depth along
    // that normal, every vertex of the touching body the track does not
    // publish stays strictly in front of the support plane, and the source
    // features are stable. Depth is the track&#39;s Band(). The track may end
    // before the duration.
    SweepPersistentBand
)</pre>

<a name="LiftSweepReport"></a>
#### func LiftSweepReport

<pre>func LiftSweepReport[B1, F1, E1, V1 <a href="https://pkg.go.dev/builtin#any">any</a>, R <a href="#SweepReplay">SweepReplay</a>, B2, F2, E2, V2 <a href="https://pkg.go.dev/builtin#any">any</a>](key seal.Key, r *<a href="#SweepReportOf">SweepReportOf</a>[B1, F1, E1, V1, R],
    l *<a href="#Lift">Lift</a>[B1, F1, E1, V1, B2, F2, E2, V2]) *<a href="#SweepReportOf">SweepReportOf</a>[B2, F2, E2, V2, R]</pre>

LiftSweepReport returns r with every body, face, edge and vertex reference
mapped by l. The replay proof, the paths, the request and the exact bracket
end carry over; each sample keeps its exact fraction, and the contact track
keeps its producer record. A report whose Event is its InitialEvent keeps
them one event. A nil report stays nil.

#### func (\*SweepReportOf\[B, F, E, V, R\]) CertifiedPosesAt

CertifiedPosesAt evaluates the recorded paths at elapsed time and checks
their rounded placements against the sweep's exact source proof.
It reads no Document geometry and performs no new contact query. A pose whose
rounding can change the reported relation beyond PointResolution is refused.

CertifiedPosesAtInterval maps an exact held time from \[start, end\] onto the
certified spatial path. It permits a caller to replay a slice whose global
clock endpoints differ slightly from the rounded sweep duration.

<a name="SweepRequest"></a>
### type SweepRequest

<pre>type SweepRequest struct {
    <a href="#ContactRequest">ContactRequest</a>
    TimeResolution     units.Value
    MaxPoseEvaluations <a href="https://pkg.go.dev/builtin#uint64">uint64</a>
    StartPolicy        <a href="#SweepStartPolicy">SweepStartPolicy</a>
    RestSpeed          units.Value
}</pre>

SweepRequest bounds the time search and the contact geometry resolution.

RestSpeed is a nonnegative Velocity; the zero Value rests no vertex. A band
track over a support set (agent-docs/multibody-dynamics-design.md §10.5) holds a
lifted vertex that closes on the support plane no faster than RestSpeed, or
rises, on both sides of the plane, as it holds a contact vertex (§10.8), so
the track does not end where that vertex's lower height bound reaches the
plane. A departure rests nothing.

ToleranceState is one reading's verdict against the caller's relative
tolerance gate (verification §2).

<a name="ToleranceNotEvaluated"></a><a name="ToleranceSatisfied"></a><a name="ToleranceExceeded"></a><a name="ToleranceUndecided"></a>

<pre>const (
    // ToleranceNotEvaluated — no precision decision was made. Two cases
    // share this state: the reading does not exist at all, and the reading
    // exists but its precision was deliberately not judged, as for an
    // invalid body&#39;s area and bounds, which are published as boundary data
    // with the tolerance check skipped.
    ToleranceNotEvaluated <a href="#ToleranceState">ToleranceState</a> = iota
    // ToleranceSatisfied — the gate accepted the bound.
    ToleranceSatisfied
    // ToleranceExceeded — the gate compared against a usable reference and
    // rejected the bound.
    ToleranceExceeded
    // ToleranceUndecided — a nonzero bound had no usable reference.
    ToleranceUndecided
)</pre>

<a name="ToleranceState.String"></a>
#### func (ToleranceState) String

<pre>func (t <a href="#ToleranceState">ToleranceState</a>) String() <a href="https://pkg.go.dev/builtin#string">string</a></pre>

String renders the pinned lower-snake token. An out-of-range value renders
"tolerance\_state(\<n\>)", never a panic.

<a name="UndercutRequest"></a>
### type UndercutRequest

<pre>type UndercutRequest struct {
    PullDirection r3.Vec
}</pre>

UndercutRequest is the effective WithPullDirection spec (proposal §5): the
exact accepted pull vector, unnormalized.

<a name="UndercutResultOf"></a>
### type UndercutResultOf

<pre>type UndercutResultOf[BodyT <a href="https://pkg.go.dev/builtin#comparable">comparable</a>, FaceT <a href="https://pkg.go.dev/builtin#any">any</a>, CellT <a href="https://pkg.go.dev/builtin#any">any</a>] struct {
    Request     *<a href="#UndercutRequest">UndercutRequest</a>
    Coverage    <a href="#Coverage">Coverage</a>
    Faces       []FaceT
    Assessment  <a href="#Assessment">Assessment</a>
    Diagnostics []<a href="#DiagnosticOf">DiagnosticOf</a>[BodyT, CellT]
}</pre>

UndercutResultOf is one body's undercut survey result (proposal §7): every
face in Faces is a CONFIRMED opposing face against the requested pull; no
uncertain face appears. Faces appear once each, in their body's Faces()
order.

<a name="ValidityOutcome"></a>
### type ValidityOutcome

<pre>type ValidityOutcome <a href="https://pkg.go.dev/builtin#int">int</a></pre>

ValidityOutcome is one body's held-boundary validity verdict (proposal §9).
ValidityValid entails the watertightness, manifoldness, and lack of
self-intersection the proof gives for that solid; ValidityInvalid and
ValidityUndecided establish no independent per-property verdict.

<a name="ValidityNotEvaluated"></a><a name="ValidityValid"></a><a name="ValidityInvalid"></a><a name="ValidityUndecided"></a>

<pre>const (
    // ValidityNotEvaluated is the reserved zero value: only a zero or
    // caller-created record carries it, never a value Verify returns.
    ValidityNotEvaluated <a href="#ValidityOutcome">ValidityOutcome</a> = iota
    // ValidityValid — the evaluator&#39;s construction and the boundary audit
    // prove the body a valid solid.
    ValidityValid
    // ValidityInvalid — a concrete invalid-solid proof exists.
    ValidityInvalid
    // ValidityUndecided — the current evidence cannot decide validity.
    ValidityUndecided
)</pre>

<a name="ValidityOutcome.String"></a>
#### func (ValidityOutcome) String

<pre>func (v <a href="#ValidityOutcome">ValidityOutcome</a>) String() <a href="https://pkg.go.dev/builtin#string">string</a></pre>

String renders the pinned lower-snake token. An out-of-range value renders
"validity\_outcome(\<n\>)", never a panic.

<a name="ValidityResultOf"></a>
### type ValidityResultOf

<pre>type ValidityResultOf[BodyT <a href="https://pkg.go.dev/builtin#comparable">comparable</a>, CellT <a href="https://pkg.go.dev/builtin#any">any</a>] struct {
    Outcome     <a href="#ValidityOutcome">ValidityOutcome</a>
    Diagnostics []<a href="#DiagnosticOf">DiagnosticOf</a>[BodyT, CellT]
}</pre>

ValidityResultOf is one body's validity verdict and the diagnostic that
explains it (proposal §9): at most one entry, since a body carries exactly
one underlying validity finding.

### type VectorReading

    <a href="#VecMeasurement">VecMeasurement</a>

<a name="VerifyRequest"></a>
### type VerifyRequest

<pre>type VerifyRequest struct {
    RelativeTolerance units.Value
    Wall              *<a href="#WallRequest">WallRequest</a>
    Undercut          *<a href="#UndercutRequest">UndercutRequest</a>
    ConcaveRadius     <a href="https://pkg.go.dev/builtin#bool">bool</a>
    Clearances        <a href="https://pkg.go.dev/builtin#bool">bool</a>
}</pre>

VerifyRequest is one Verify call's effective settings (proposal §5),
recorded on Report.Request even for an empty document. Wall is non-nil
exactly when WithMinWallThickness was requested, Undercut exactly when
WithPullDirection was; WallResult.Request and UndercutResult.Request point
at these same records.

<a name="WallRequest"></a>
### type WallRequest

<pre>type WallRequest struct {
    Minimum        units.Value
    DraftAllowance units.Value
}</pre>

WallRequest is the effective WithMinWallThickness spec (proposal §5):
canonicalized to millimetres and radians.

<a name="WallResultOf"></a>
### type WallResultOf

<pre>type WallResultOf[BodyT <a href="https://pkg.go.dev/builtin#comparable">comparable</a>, CellT <a href="https://pkg.go.dev/builtin#any">any</a>] struct {
    Request     *<a href="#WallRequest">WallRequest</a>
    Outcome     <a href="#ScalarOutcome">ScalarOutcome</a>
    Minimum     *<a href="#ScalarReading">ScalarReading</a>
    Assessment  <a href="#Assessment">Assessment</a>
    Diagnostics []<a href="#DiagnosticOf">DiagnosticOf</a>[BodyT, CellT]
}</pre>

WallResultOf is one body's wall survey result (proposal §6). Request is
non-nil exactly for a requested survey and shares the pointer
[VerifyRequest](<#VerifyRequest>).Wall carries. Diagnostics is this result's own local
findings: the survey's own explanation (or the DiagSurveyPrerequisite a
non-valid body's validity substitutes for it), plus the reading's own
precision finding when it fired.
